title: Join a session: Waiting, Refused, Approved, Room open, Reconnect
covers: Joined sessions card states, Forget, Reconnect to
context: A join keeps its state in the card under Joined sessions: Waiting for the host, Refused (only Forget is offered), Approved and Room open with the addresses. After a restart the card reads Not connected with a button Reconnect to and the session name.
changed: views/JoinSession joined card and joins store

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: game
setup.text: A Link to the Past installed: Library, Games, tab Built-in, press Add on its card.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: session
setup.text: A saved session with Allow direct connections and Allow unlisted clients on and one player, as in the test Session tab: a second client joins.

steps: Run the session so its tab opens Copy the session code and the Lobby address In Join a session look at the session, fill Your player (A Link to the Past, Game defaults, Player name Guest1, Your name Guest) and press Join as
The card under Joined sessions reads Waiting for the host.
In the tab press Refuse followed by Guest on the new card. The join card reads Refused and only Forget followed by the session name is offered. Press it. The card is gone.
Join again with another player name. In the tab press Approve on the new card. The join card reads Approved.
Press Run in the tab and wait for Hosting. The join card reads Room open with Room address, On this computer, Slot, Game and Seed.
Close Archipelia completely and launch it again with the same command. Open Sessions, then Join a session. The card shows Not connected with a button Reconnect to and the session name.
Press Reconnect to. If the host session is still open the card moves on. If the session is gone, the card says so in a sentence.
pass: The card moves through Waiting for the host, Approved and Room open, and Refused offers only Forget.
After a restart the join is still there as Not connected and Reconnect to answers with a result or a sentence.
fail: The card shows a wrong state, or Refused offers anything but Forget.
The join is lost after a restart, or Reconnect to shows a code or a blank line.
notes: Here one app is both host and guest, so closing Archipelia also closes the host room. The sentence that the session is gone is a valid result for step 7. A second computer gives the full reconnect.
Forget removes the card only on this side.
